title: Flaky: CanNewAndBuild(aspire-xunit, Net8) fails with Roslyn Method not found EncodingExtensions.TryGetMaxCharCount on macOS
test_name: Aspire.Templates.Tests.XUnit_V3_NewUpAndBuildSupportProjectTemplatesTests.CanNewAndBuild(templateName: "aspire-xunit", extraTestCreationArgs: "--xunit-version v3", sdk: Net8, tfm: Net8, error: null)
error_pattern: Aspire.Templates.Tests.ToolCommandException :  Expected 0 exit code but got 1: dotnet build ... CSC : error CS1504: Source file '.../AssemblyAttributes.cs' could not be opened -- Method not found: 'Boolean Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.EncodingExtensions.TryGetMaxCharCount(System.Text.Encoding, Int64, Int32 ByRef)'.
analysis: This is a Roslyn compiler 'Method not found' error surfacing during a generated template project's build on the macOS runner, indicating a binary version mismatch between the Roslyn compiler and Microsoft.CodeAnalysis assembly loaded on that machine image. This mirrors a previously observed sibling issue (HashAlgorithmToPal Method not found on macOS, issue #18950) which is a known environmental/SDK compatibility problem unrelated to any Aspire template or PR source changes. The PR under analysis (#20279) only modifies DCP executor/orchestrator files, not templates or Roslyn tooling.
